messages:
lou_finance: Heads up  customer Orchid Therapy (acct OR-221) invoice #6204 declined with `do_not_honor`. Putting thread here to coordinate next steps.

eli_ops: How many auto-retries left? @stripe-bot

stripe-bot: Charge `ch_9LmNoP` has 2 scheduled retry attempts remaining.

harper_cs: I just spoke to Priya, billing contact. They swapped banks and asked not to retry the old card. They want to pay today via wire.

morgan_revops: We usually offer to cover small incoming fees for first-time issues. Finance ok with up to $40? @lou_finance

lou_finance: Approve up to $40. Pause auto-retries and place invoice in "manual_payment" status. Add note about fee courtesy.

eli_ops: Pausing retries now and cancelling scheduled attempts. Tagging acct OR-221 with `no_auto_retry:7d`. OPS ticket FIN-4012 created.

harper_cs: I'll email Priya with our wire instructions and confirmation we'll reimburse up to $40 of bank fees if they include the receipt.

morgan_revops: Please use this wording: "We've paused card attempts. If you wire today, send the bank receipt and we'll apply payment same-day and reimburse up to $40 of fees."

lou_finance: Also note in billing portal: link invoice to FIN-4012 and set expected payment method = wire.

harper_cs: Sending now. Excerpt of message: "Hi Priya  we've paused retries. Wire details below. Once you initiate, reply with the bank confirmation and we'll post immediately and reimburse up to $40 of incoming fees. Beneficiary: Redwood Inference Inc.; Account: 4455667788; ABA: 111000025; SWIFT: RINFUS55; Ref: INV-6204"

eli_ops: Done. I'll monitor incoming payments and mark FIN-4012 when settled. Suppressing webhook-driven retries for 7 days.

lou_finance: Thanks. If they instead prefer ACH, Harper please send ACH microdeposit steps and keep us posted. Closing this coordination thread, will reopen if any escalation.
